household_12

Source: R/household_12.R
household_12.Rd

Household survey of the ENSE 2011/12.

Usage

household_12

Format

A data frame with 55806 rows and 66 variables:

CCAA

autonomous community code

IDENTHOGAR

household identifier

ESTRATO

sampling stratum

SEXO_i

sex of the reference person

EDAD_i

age of the reference person

NORDEN_Ai

order number of the adult reference person

NORDEN_Mi

order number of the minor reference person

NADULTOS

number of adults in the household

NMENORES

number of minors in the household

About rOpenSpain

rOpenSpain is a community of enthusiasts of R, open data, and reproducibility that comes together and organizes itself to create R packages of the highest quality for the analysis and use of Spanish data of general interest.

"rOpenSci is our form, Spanish public data our matter"
